seoTitle: Redirect Shopify's Add to Cart Button to Affiliate
metaDescription: Replace Shopify's Add to Cart or Buy Now button with a redirect to an external affiliate link, ideal for running an affiliate storefront.
intro: Running an affiliate-style Shopify store means sending shoppers to another marketplace instead of your own checkout, and that requires editing the button behavior directly. This guide covers locating the right button snippet in your theme code and replacing the checkout link with your affiliate URL for both Buy Now and Add to Cart buttons.

steps.heading: Understand why you'd redirect to an affiliate link
steps.body: If you're running an affiliate store, sending customers to another marketplace or supplier's product page instead of your own checkout is often the whole point of the setup.

steps.heading: Locate the button code in the theme editor
steps.body: Open your theme's code editor and find the snippet responsible for the Add to Cart or Buy Now button behavior.

steps.heading: Add a custom affiliate redirect link
steps.body: Replace the existing checkout link in that snippet with your affiliate URL so clicking the button sends visitors off-site instead.

steps.heading: Review final tips for an affiliate Shopify store
steps.body: Once the redirect is working for both button types, double-check that the experience still looks professional and consistent with the rest of your store.

faq.question: Does this work for both Buy Now and Add to Cart buttons?
faq.answer: Yes, the method covers replacing both the Buy Now and Add to Cart buttons with an affiliate redirect.

faq.question: Do I need to edit theme code to do this?
faq.answer: Yes, this requires editing your theme code to locate the button snippet and replace the checkout link with your affiliate URL.

faq.question: Will my store still look normal to visitors?
faq.answer: Yes, the goal is to keep your store looking professional while functioning as an affiliate hub that redirects purchases externally.

faq.question: Is this reversible if I want to go back to a normal checkout?
faq.answer: Since the change is made in your theme code, reverting to the original checkout link would restore the standard Shopify checkout behavior.
